verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device and hosted inference SDK/CLI. The evidence shows developer primitives (LLM generation, structured output, tool calling, VLM) that a developer could use to build an insights feature. Nothing shows the product itself analyzing a user's data and surfacing AI-generated insights or suggestions. Those primitives are building blocks only and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
